result:
The newsletter sign-up is in place as a self-contained module, and `bunx guren gate` passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, and all 20 tests). `bunx guren check` and `check --arch` report no failures. I also confirmed the boundary rule by temporarily adding an importing file under `app/` and one under `routes/`: each was reported as an architecture failure, and both probes are removed.

Two behaviours you might not assume from the request:

- **Referer redirect:** subscribe and unsubscribe only follow the `Referer` when it is on the request's own origin; anything else goes to `/`, so the endpoints can't be used as an open redirect.
- **Email case:** addresses are lowercased before storing, so `Reader@Example.com` and `reader@example.com` count as the same subscriber.

Nothing was committed; the changes are in the working tree.

**Summary of changes:** I scaffolded `modules/newsletter/` with `guren make:module`, which registered `newsletterModule` in `src/app.ts` and added the schema re-export to the root `db/schema.ts`. Inside the module I wrote `index.ts` (prefix `/newsletter`), `routes.ts` (the three routes, with the confirm route bound to the `token` column so an unknown token answers 404), `db/schema.ts` (the `newsletter_subscriptions` table), `app/Models/NewsletterSubscription.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/NewsletterValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/NewsletterController.ts` (64-character random hex token, 422 under `email` for invalid or duplicate addresses), and `tests/controllers/NewsletterController.test.ts` (17 tests). Outside the module I generated the migration `db/migrations/20260929161812_create_newsletter_subscriptions/`, added `guren.arch.ts` forbidding `app/**` and `routes/**` from importing anything under `modules/newsletter/**` (type-only imports included), added `modules/**/*` to `tsconfig.json` so the module is typechecked, recorded the decision in `docs/adr/0002-newsletter-sign-up-as-a-self-contained-module.md`, and regenerated `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts`.
